{{Top|leg}}
'''Marrev testing''' was a type of test used for measuring one's tactical intelligence. According to the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', one of the requirements for recruits into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] included a marrev testing result of 790 or higher.
